About
School of Computer Science and Information Technology
About
Empowering tomorrow’s professionals and creating a better world through technology-driven solutions
Our reputation is built upon impactful research that pushes the boundaries of how we design, use, and engage with technology. Our outstanding, industry-driven programs allow our students to work alongside researchers in first-class facilities and empower them to solve real-world problems. We aspire as a community to create a better society through creativity, compassion and innovation.
About the School of Computer Science and Information Technology
Explore our study areas
Our IT and computer science degrees empower students with state-of-the-art skills in AI, cyber security, information systems and software engineering to become impactful citizens in a digital society.
Explore our study areas
Discover our research
Our pioneering research in Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Human Centred Computing, Software and Information System, and Information Management is strengthened by extensive industry collaboration.
